notes:
Device pipeline must match training:
1) Build features in order: acc(3), gyro(3), speed_mps, turn_rate_deg_s
2) If gps_valid==0: set speed/turn_rate=0 (gating)
3) For each window: subtract mean of acc channels (per-window detrend)
4) Normalize: (x - mu) / sigma
5) Quantize using model input tensor scale/zero_point to int8
6) Run int8 model; output is int8 logits -> dequantize if needed, argmax -> pred_raw
7) Apply smooth/hysteresis and Unknown/Uncertain by confidence threshold.
